brief: The 6 anti-aging habits actually backed by science.

slots.author: DR. ELENA VOSS
slots.subtitle: SIX DAILY HABITS FOR TIMELESS RADIANCE

slots.author: DR. ELENA VOSS
slots.title: DAILY SUN PROTECTION
slots.body: Ultraviolet radiation causes up to ninety percent of visible skin aging. A broad-spectrum sunscreen preserves collagen and prevents fine lines daily. It is the most potent anti-aging treatment you can wear.

slots.author: DR. ELENA VOSS
slots.title: RETINOIDS AT NIGHT
slots.body: Vitamin A derivatives accelerate cell turnover and stimulate collagen production over time. With consistent nightly use, skin texture becomes smoother and pigmentation fades gently.

slots.author: DR. ELENA VOSS
slots.title: PRIORITIZE DEEP SLEEP
slots.body: Your skin repairs itself most aggressively during deep sleep cycles. Seven to nine hours allows cortisol to drop and growth hormones to restore elasticity.

slots.author: DR. ELENA VOSS
slots.title: STAY HYDRATED ALWAYS
slots.body: Internal hydration supports the skin barrier and maintains plumpness from within. Pair water intake with a ceramide-rich moisturizer to lock in resilience.

slots.author: DR. ELENA VOSS
slots.title: MOVE YOUR BODY
slots.body: Regular exercise boosts circulation, delivering oxygen and nutrients that nourish the complexion. The resulting glow is as real as the science behind it.

slots.author: DR. ELENA VOSS
slots.title: EAT ANTIOXIDANTS DAILY
slots.body: Colorful fruits and vegetables neutralize free radicals that break down collagen fibers. A nutrient-dense plate is a foundational step toward lasting luminosity.

slots.author: DR. ELENA VOSS
slots.headline: START TODAY
slots.body: Begin your science-backed journey to radiant, ageless skin today.
